parameters.power_method: exact two-sided normal approximation using observed IVW-MRE SE
parameters.r2_method: sum of per-SNP partial R2 = F/(F+residual_df); valid as an approximation after LD clumping

unit_status.paper: TMFI is the fat-free-muscle-volume-weighted average of four regional MRI-derived TMFI measures.
unit_status.most_likely_gwas_beta_unit: raw TMFI units, likely percentage points; implied SD is about 2.03 units.
unit_status.conflict: The article states continuous fastGWA-mlm, while the public GWAS.txt contains --fastGWA-mlm-binary. Exact preprocessing is not documented.
unit_status.reporting_rule: Use standardized effects for primary power interpretation until authors clarify the GWAS phenotype coding/unit.
